method: Each place checked on its operator's own website (or the public body that runs it) by automated fetch; no review sites, maps or blogs.

confirmed.name: Vatican Museums
confirmed.sourceType: official public operator (Vatican Museums, Vatican City State)
confirmed.operatingEvidence: The hours page lists 2026 closures, e.g. the Carriage Pavilion "closed 20–23 October" and regular closures on 1 November and 8, 25 and 26 December. Tickets are sold at "tickets.museivaticani.va", and the site warns of scam sites with similar domains.
confirmed.hours: "From Monday to Saturday 08.00 a.m. – 08.00 p.m. (final entry 06.00 p.m.)"; "Every last Sunday of the month 09.00 a.m. – 02.00 p.m. (final entry 12.30 p.m.)" with free entry; other Sundays closed.

confirmed.name: St. Peter's Basilica

confirmed.address: No street address published; security entrance is in "the right hemicycle of Saint Peter's Square looking towards the Basilica".
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Dated 2026 news, including "New opening hours for St Peter's Basilica" (28 May) and a sacred music concert on Saturday 10 October. Hours are given for "October 26, 2026 to March 28, 2027".
confirmed.hours: Basilica 07:00–20:00 until 25 October 2026, then 07:00–19:00 from 26 October 2026 to 28 March 2027. Dome: 7:00–18:00 in summer, 7:30–17:00 in winter.

confirmed.name: Pantheon

confirmed.address: Piazza della Rotonda, 00186 Roma RM, Italy
confirmed.operatingEvidence: "BOOK NOW" ticket link and 2026-dated news posts (e.g. 24 March, 12 March). Lists a "First Sunday of the month free entry" option.

confirmed.name: Trevi Fountain
confirmed.address: "Ingresso: Via della Stamperia" (ticket office); exit on Via dei Crociferi.
confirmed.operatingEvidence: Ticketing for non-residents since 2 February 2026: "Scopri come entrare dal 2 febbraio 2026". The inner perimeter costs €2 for non-residents. Pre-bought tickets are "open, senza data e orario" and cannot be refunded.
confirmed.hours: Monday and Friday 11:30–22:00; other days 9:00–22:00; "Tutti i giorni ultimo ingresso 21:00". The fountain stays visible free from outside after hours.

confirmed.name: Musei Capitolini

confirmed.hours: Daily 9:30–19:30; 24 and 31 December 9:30–14:00; last admission one hour before closing; closed 1 May and 25 December.

confirmed.hours: "Everyday 9.30 - 19.30"; 24 and 31 December 9.30–14.00; last admission one hour before closing; "Closed 1 May and 25 December".

guide.summary: Vatican and Roman landmarks, civic museums, a park walk and the Appian Way park, with trattorias, pizza-by-the-slice, a bakery, a food hall and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The Vatican Museums are closed on Sundays except the last Sunday of the month, when entry is free from 9:00 to 14:00 (final entry 12:30), so plan a weekday visit or arrive early on 25 October.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Vatican Museums close on Sundays except the last Sunday of the month, and on 1 November and 8, 25 and 26 December. Galleria Doria Pamphilj closes every Wednesday, and Musei Capitolini and the Ara Pacis close on 1 May and 25 December.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Book Vatican Museums tickets only at tickets.museivaticani.va; the museums warn of scam sites with similar domains. Trevi Fountain's inner area costs €2 for non-residents, and pre-bought tickets have no date or time and cannot be refunded.

toolkit.label: Walk-in or reserve
toolkit.copy: Da Enzo al 29 takes no reservations and seats guests in order of arrival, while Armando al Pantheon takes bookings only online. Drink Kong takes online reservations for up to 6 people but none after midnight.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: St. Peter's Basilica admits only clothing appropriate for a place of worship, with no overly brief outfits, tank tops or headwear, and entry is through a police security check. Trevi Fountain bans food, drink and sitting on the basin edge, and has no cloakroom, so bring a small bag.

guide.dek: Book the Vatican Museums and your dinner slots in advance, and leave walk-in trattorias and the Trevi Fountain for flexible moments.
intro: You can build a first day in Rome around the Vatican. The Vatican Museums on Viale Vaticano open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 to 20:00, with final entry at 18:00. They are closed on Sundays except the last Sunday of the month, which is free from 9:00 to 14:00. St. Peter's Basilica opens at 7:00 and, from 26 October 2026, closes at 19:00. The dome opens 7:30 to 17:00 in winter. You enter through police security checks on the right side of St. Peter's Square, and you need clothing suited to a place of worship.

In the historic centre, the Pantheon on Piazza della Rotonda opens every day from 9:00 to 19:00, with last entry at 18:30, and its site lists free entry on the first Sunday of the month. The Trevi Fountain has charged non-residents €2 for the inner area since 2 February 2026. You enter on Via della Stamperia and leave by Via dei Crociferi. It opens at 9:00, or 11:30 on Mondays and Fridays, with last entry at 21:00. After closing you can still see it free from outside.

For museums beyond the big names, the Musei Capitolini on Piazza del Campidoglio open daily from 9:30 to 19:30. They are showing a Diego Rivera exhibition until 13 December 2026. The Ara Pacis keeps the same hours and opens a Fayum portrait exhibition on 5 November 2026, running to 2 May 2027. Galleria Doria Pamphilj, entered at Via del Corso 305, closes every Wednesday, and a standard ticket costs €16. For open air, the Passeggiata del Pincio is always open and has bike rental, and the Appia Antica park office is at Via Appia Antica 42.

Food planning matters as much as tickets. Da Enzo al 29 in Trastevere opens Monday to Saturday and takes no reservations. Armando al Pantheon books only online and is closed Saturday evening and Sunday. Supplizio on Via dei Banchi Vecchi is closed on Sundays. Antico Forno Roscioli on Via dei Chiavari opens daily at 7:30, and Mercato Centrale Roma on Via Giolitti runs daily from 7:30 to 23:30. For drinks, Drink Kong in Monti opens nightly at 18:30, and Jerry Thomas Speakeasy opens at 21:00.
summaryCards: Pair the Vatican Museums (Monday to Saturday, final entry 18:00) with St. Peter's Basilica, then cross to the Pantheon and the Trevi Fountain.
Start with bread at Antico Forno Roscioli from 7:30, then walk up to the always-open Passeggiata del Pincio.
Buy Vatican tickets only on tickets.museivaticani.va, book Armando al Pantheon online, and plan to queue at Da Enzo al 29, which takes no reservations.

limitations: This is a website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Colosseum and Roman Forum could not be checked because colosseo.it refused automated connections and the ticketing site showed a bot check. Galleria Borghese's site also refused connection, and Forno Campo de' Fiori, Sant'Eustachio Il Caffè, The Court, Trapizzino, Pasticceria Regoli and Panella could not be read (connection refused, redirect loop, 403, 500 or maintenance page). Roscioli publishes no street address, and no official sites were found for Barnum Cafe, Marigold, Pergamino, the Spanish Steps or Villa Borghese. Hours are not published for La Pergola, Pizzarium or the Appia Antica park. St. Peter's Basilica gives no street address, and Da Enzo al 29 does not state its Sunday status. Jerry Thomas Speakeasy's site carries no 2026-dated content beyond live hours and booking. Only 18 places were confirmed, below the 25–35 target.
